'''Arnell Hyland''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for her relative [[Addalar Hyland]]'s company [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
